have h_main : DoubleQuadruple_postcond (x) (DoubleQuadruple (x) h_precond) h_precond := by
    dsimp [DoubleQuadruple, DoubleQuadruple_postcond] at *
    <;>
    (try simp_all) <;>
    (try ring_nf) <;>
    (try norm_num) <;>
    (try constructor <;> ring_nf <;> norm_num) <;>
    (try simp_all [Prod.fst, Prod.snd]) <;>
    (try norm_num) <;>
    (try ring_nf) <;>
    (try linarith)
    <;>
    (try
      {
        constructor <;>
        simp_all [Prod.fst, Prod.snd] <;>
        ring_nf <;>
        norm_num <;>
        linarith
      })
    <;>
    (try
      {
        simp_all [Prod.fst, Prod.snd]
        <;>
        ring_nf
        <;>
        norm_num
        <;>
        linarith
      })
  exact h_main
